items.sottotitolo: A public archive of contracts for migrant reception services in Italy. Data I collected, cleaned and put online.

ANAC, Italian Ministry of the Interior

items.limite: The limits of the data are stated on the methodology page: incomplete coverage, amounts that cannot be summed, per-person cost not derivable.

voci.p: Three ANAC datasets merged in Python: monthly downloads, normalisation, a two-level filter with a confidence index. A 2015–2025 archive, versioned in the repository.

voci.h: Ninety ministerial PDFs, read by a machine
voci.p: The series on unaccompanied foreign minors lived only inside ministry reports. pdfplumber extracts them: 84 monthly reports from 2016 to 2022, then half-yearly ones through 2025.
Next.js and TypeScript on Vercel, hand-written CSS. A GitHub Actions workflow opens the update reminder each month. Technical SEO, structured data, all open source.

items.sottotitolo: A business tool for growth and online authority: a team of AI agents produces geo/EO-targeted content, autoblogging and business analysis. Co-founder, from product to launch.

apparato.dd: Next.js · TypeScript · Supabase · Claude API · Search Console

voci.p: Next.js and TypeScript, Supabase database. As co-founder: architecture, deployment, and the functions that move an article from draft to publication.
Specialised AI agents: content tuned for geographic and generative search, scheduled autoblogging, analysis of the client's business. I write the prompts; tone shifts from client to client.
Editorial plans read against Search Console, measuring the authority gained. I optimise for people searching Google and for people asking a model. No article ships without human review.

items.sottotitolo: Two years on an electrical and plumbing supplies e-commerce turning over around €20,000 a day: theme built from scratch on Open2B, integrations, internal applications, tracking.

apparato.dd: PHP · JavaScript · MySQL · Open2B/Scriggo · GTM/GA4 · Brevo · Cloudflare

voci.p: A complete Open2B/Scriggo template, rebuilt mobile-first. Checkout cut from three pages to one, dynamic search filters, dark theme, a department mega-menu, a product page with spec sheets, reviews and real-time stock.
Open2B ↔ Brevo sync for contacts and catalogue. Product feeds generated for Trovaprezzi, Kelkoo, Google Merchant and Doofinder, filtered by availability and priced by weight band.
Apps on the Open2B API for the work the office did by hand: pulling orders and customers, sorting by tax area, checking shipped quantities, archiving receipts, generating product descriptions.
GA4 e-commerce via GTM, Facebook Pixel, Microsoft UET and Clarity. Purchase-funnel events mapped one by one, from product view to purchase, reading data from the DOM rather than fragile variables.
Cookiebot and Consent Mode v2: no cookies before consent, tags that fire only with the right category, anonymous pre-consent tracking to keep the aggregate data. Cookies classified in four languages.
VAT validation over Cerved and VIES across 28 EU countries, with auto-fill at checkout. Postcode autocomplete over Italian towns, interdependent shipping and payment rules handled client-side.

LCP from 12 to 4 seconds, TBT down 40%. CSS rewritten mobile-first and split by section, media queries in a separate file, images and Lighthouse scores gone through. Apps optimised to handle tens of thousands of products and orders.

Heading structure rebuilt for SEO, Feedaty structured data validated for stars in the SERPs. WAVE and axe accessibility audits, viewport made zoomable again. Cloudflare for CDN and protection, A+ on security headers.

Ongoing maintenance of the site and the management system, on an annual fee.
